params.name: lang
params.description: Language code for localized strings (e.g. en, de, es).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of webcams to return (max 50).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for pagination. Max offset is 1000 (free) or 10000 (professional).

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma-separated list of category slugs to filter by.

params.name: continents
params.description: Comma-separated list of continent codes to filter by.

params.name: countries
params.description: Comma-separated list of ISO country codes to filter by.

params.name: regions
params.description: Comma-separated list of region codes to filter by.

params.name: nearby
params.description: Filter to webcams near a point, as "lat,lon,radius" in km.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of detail objects to include in each webcam: categories, images, location, player, urls.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of webcams. Results can be filtered by category, country, continent, region, and bounding box, and enriched with optional includes such as images, location, player, and urls.

info.name: Get a single webcam by ID.

params.name: webcamId
params.description: The numeric identifier of the webcam.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of detail objects to include: categories, images, location, player, urls.

items.docs: Returns details for a single webcam, optionally enriched with include objects.
